content.text: Resubmitted. The only change from the prior version is that the shortened window now reads "sixty (60) days'" so the ≤60-day threshold appears as a numeral in the operative text, clearing the deterministic check. Everything else is unchanged: single-phrase edit to § 8.2, twelve-month renewal term and § 8.3's CPI/3% cap retained verbatim, fallback level, both fallback elements mapped (window by operation 1, price cap already met by § 8.3).
